data.content_ref: inline:The target never provides the causal mechanism that ensures completed evidence escapes the workspace before reclamation. It states that unreferenced workspace state is reclaimed, but the problem explicitly describes a crash while the process is holding the workspace. Without a described causal barrier—such as a mandatory workspace-to-store sync, a two-phase commit protocol, or an invariant that completed evidence is never buffered in the workspace—any completed evidence still residing in the workspace at the moment of crash would be silently displaced by the very reclamation rule the target proposes. The append-only immutable store only protects evidence already inside it; the target leaves the critical workspace-to-store gap causally unbridged, so the claimed guarantee fails.
